name: TAKAFUL
recent: Takaful Malaysia 近期获得多家机构投资者（EPF、KWAP）的股权变动申报，同时新闻聚焦其零售业务增长计划与2026年第二季度业绩表现。公司第二季度回教保险收入达20亿令吉，但净利润环比下降12%。
notable: EPF 和 KWAP 在2026年9月多次申报股权变动。
公司公布2026年第二季度业绩，回教保险收入20亿令吉，税前及天课前利润3.056亿令吉。
管理层表示零售业务是下一个增长引擎。
risks: 2026年第二季度净利润环比下降12.0%。
服务费用大幅增加导致季度环比下滑。
earnings: 2026年第二季度收入为10.17亿令吉，环比增长9.8%，同比增长16.2%；净利润为8883.5万令吉，环比下降12.0%，同比增长6.0%；净利润率为8.7%，低于上一季度的10.9%。

recent_en: Takaful Malaysia recently saw shareholding changes reported by institutional investors (EPF, KWAP), while news focused on its retail business growth plans and 2Q 2026 results. The company posted RM2.0 billion in takaful revenue for 2Q, but net income fell 12% quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple shareholding change notices in September 2026.
The company reported 2Q 2026 results with RM2.0 billion takaful revenue and RM305.6 million profit before zakat and tax.
Management identified retail business as the next growth engine.
risks_en: A sharp increase in service expenses led to the sequential decline.
earnings_en: 2Q 2026 revenue was RM1,016.8 million, up 9.8% QoQ and 16.2% YoY; net income was RM88.8 million, down 12.0% QoQ but up 6.0% YoY; net margin was 8.7%, lower than 10.9% in the previous quarter.
